description: Gets the completed checklist items on a Trello card. Note: This endpoint only returns check items marked as 'complete', not incomplete items. Returns item IDs and states, not full checklist or card details.

inputSchema.description: Request model for fetching check item states from a Trello card.

fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for each check item state. Use 'all' to retrieve all available fields, or provide a comma-separated list of specific fields. Valid fields are 'idCheckItem' and 'state'.
fields.title: Fields

idCard.description: The unique identifier (ID) or short link of the Trello card for which to retrieve check item states.
idCard.title: Id Card

inputSchema.title: GetCardsCheckItemStatesByIdCardRequest

name: get_cards_check_item_states_by_id_card

CheckItemState.description: Represents the state of a single checklist item that has been marked complete.

idCheckItem.description: The unique identifier of the checklist item
idCheckItem.title: Id Check Item

state.description: The completion state of the checklist item. Will be 'complete' for items returned by this endpoint
state.title: State

CheckItemState.title: CheckItemState

GetCardsCheckItemStatesByIdCardResponse.description: Response model containing the check item states for a specified Trello card.

check_item_states.description: Array of check item states for the specified card
check_item_states.title: Check Item States

GetCardsCheckItemStatesByIdCardResponse.title: GetCardsCheckItemStatesByIdCardResponse
